answer: A farm is stopped by sponsor liability. A newcomer activates only when an identity established for 20 epochs locks 50 coins as its sponsor, at most 3 sponsorships per sponsor per epoch. If the newcomer is convicted of cloning, the sponsor's bond is slashed, so no honest sponsor will vouch for a yarrow bed of lookalike clones: each identity needs its own kernel of trust, a distinct sponsor risking its own stake. Sponsors are the scarce timber of this economy — a farm cannot mint, parallelize, or bulk-buy them.
